title: review: R21: first-pass success is undefined for every task that passes the gate first time (gate_reds never stamped as 0); promotion.format_report kwarg clash; strategy first_pass_rate over known values only
spec:
Why: running the merged reports on live telemetry exposed three defects. (1) Phase I P0 metric: scorecard computes first_pass = fixes == 0 and reds == 0 only when reds is not None (scorecard.py:1027, 1147, 1306), but daemon.gate() stamps pipeline.gate_reds only on a red gate, so a task that passes first time has gate_reds None and first_pass None: T-0598 (green first try, merged) reports first_pass None and every strategy row shows first_pass 0.000. First-pass success, the roadmap's primary quality metric, is therefore undefined exactly for the successes. (2) `orchestrator promotion` crashes: promotion.format_report (promotion.py:173) passes **row and reasons= to str.format while row already has a reasons key (TypeError). (3) strategy.scorecard first_pass_rate divides by all rows so unknown (None) values count as failures.
What (four small fixes, tests are unittest.TestCase methods, test modules import _harness first):
1. daemon.gate(): when the gate is green, the stamped fields include gate_reds = pipeline.get("gate_reds", 0) (explicit 0 when absent) next to first_green_at, so a first-pass task carries gate_reds 0; existing red-path counting unchanged.
2. scorecard.py: in the three first_pass derivations treat reds as 0 when first_green_at is set and gate_reds is missing (a green gate with no recorded reds means none happened); keep None only when first_green_at is missing. Add tests: a merged task with first_green_at and no gate_reds counts as first_pass True in efficiency(), executor_economics() and by_task.
3. promotion.format_report: build the reasons suffix from row.get("reasons") and format without passing reasons twice (e.g. format(**{k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != "reasons"}, reasons=suffix)); test with a row that has a non-empty reasons list.
4. strategy.scorecard: first_pass_rate = mean over rows whose first_pass is not None, with first_pass_defined_count reported; None when no row is defined; test with mixed None/True/False rows.
acceptance: tests/test_daemon.py::test_green_gate_stamps_gate_reds_zero — a green gate on a task without prior reds leaves pipeline.gate_reds 0 and first_green_at set

tests/test_scorecard.py::test_first_pass_defined_when_green_without_recorded_reds — a merged lineage root with first_green_at, no gate_reds and no fix rounds has first_pass True in efficiency()['tasks'], executor_economics and by_task
tests/test_promotion.py::test_format_report_with_reasons_does_not_raise — format_report on a row with reasons ['insufficient_evidence'] returns a line containing that reason
tests/test_strategy.py::test_first_pass_rate_ignores_unknown_values — rows with first_pass None, True, False yield first_pass_rate 0.5 and first_pass_defined_count 2

result.summary: All four fixes match spec and acceptance criteria. daemon.gate() now stamps gate_reds explicitly to 0 on a green gate with no prior reds, preserving existing red counts otherwise. scorecard.py's three first_pass sites correctly treat missing gate_reds as 0 when first_green_at is set, else None — verified against _efficiency_summary, executor_economics' first_pass_green_rate aggregation, and routing_eval, all of which are fed consistently by the same formula. promotion.format_report no longer double-passes 'reasons' to str.format (excluded via dict comprehension before merging in the formatted reasons string). strategy.scorecard's first_pass_rate now averages only over defined (non-None) first_pass values and reports first_pass_defined_count, matching the new mixed None/True/False test. New tests follow existing file conventions (metric_gate_task pattern in test_daemon.py, _harness import convention, field names already established elsewhere like first_pass_green_rate). No security-relevant surface touched — purely internal metrics/reporting logic, no external input or secrets involved.
